description: Repo-scale (php-library): add pagination to LoanService::listLoansForMember that must compose with the existing status filter, not bypass it
prompts: Add `LoanService::listLoansForMember(int $memberId, ?string $status = null, int $page = 1, int $pageSize = 20): array`. `$status`, when given, filters to loans with that status ("active"/"returned"). `$page` (1-based) and `$pageSize` (max 100) must both be positive integers - throw LibraryException otherwise. It returns `['loans' => ..., 'total' => ..., 'page' => ..., 'pageSize' => ...]`, where `loans` is just that page's slice and `total` is the count of ALL matching loans (not just the page). Pagination must be applied AFTER the status filter, not before - `total` must reflect the filtered count, and the returned `loans` must be the correct page of the FILTERED result set.

test_setup_files.tests/LoanPaginationTest.php:
<?php

use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

require_once __DIR__ . '/../src/LoanService.php';

final class LoanPaginationTest extends TestCase
{
    public function testPaginationComposesWithStatusFilter(): void
    {
        $books = new \App\BookRepository();
        $members = new \App\MemberRepository();
        $loans = new \App\LoanRepository();
        $service = new \App\LoanService($books, $members, $loans);

        $member = $members->create('Ada', 'a@example.com');

        // 5 active, 3 returned loans for this member.
        $active = [];
        for ($i = 0; $i < 5; $i++) {
            $book = $books->create("Book $i", 'x', 1);
            $active[] = $service->borrow($book->id, $member->id);
        }
        for ($i = 0; $i < 3; $i++) {
            $book = $books->create("Returned $i", 'x', 1);
            $loan = $service->borrow($book->id, $member->id);
            $service->returnLoan($loan->id);
        }

        $page1 = $service->listLoansForMember($member->id, 'active', 1, 2);
        $this->assertSame(5, $page1['total']);
        $this->assertCount(2, $page1['loans']);
        foreach ($page1['loans'] as $loan) {
            $this->assertSame('active', $loan->status);
        }

        $page3 = $service->listLoansForMember($member->id, 'active', 3, 2);
        $this->assertCount(1, $page3['loans']);

        $this->expectException(\App\LibraryException::class);
        $service->listLoansForMember($member->id, null, 0);
    }
}

reference_solution.src/LoanService.php:
<?php

namespace App;

require_once __DIR__ . '/BookRepository.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/MemberRepository.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/LoanRepository.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/LibraryException.php';

class LoanService
{
    private BookRepository $books;
    private MemberRepository $members;
    private LoanRepository $loans;

    public function __construct(BookRepository $books, MemberRepository $members, LoanRepository $loans)
    {
        $this->books = $books;
        $this->members = $members;
        $this->loans = $loans;
    }

    public function borrow(int $bookId, int $memberId): Loan
    {
        $book = $this->books->find($bookId);
        if ($book === null) {
            throw new LibraryException('book not found');
        }
        $member = $this->members->find($memberId);
        if ($member === null) {
            throw new LibraryException('member not found');
        }
        if ($book->availableCopies <= 0) {
            throw new LibraryException('no copies available');
        }

        $book->availableCopies--;
        return $this->loans->create($bookId, $memberId, 'active');
    }

    public function returnLoan(int $loanId): Loan
    {
        $loan = $this->loans->find($loanId);
        if ($loan === null) {
            throw new LibraryException('loan not found');
        }
        if ($loan->status !== 'active') {
            throw new LibraryException('loan already returned');
        }

        $loan->status = 'returned';
        $book = $this->books->find($loan->bookId);
        if ($book !== null) {
            $book->availableCopies++;
        }
        return $loan;
    }

    /**
     * Lists a member's loans, optionally filtered by status, with
     * pagination applied AFTER the filter. Returns an array with
     * 'loans' (this page's slice), 'total' (count of ALL matching
     * loans), 'page', 'pageSize'.
     */
    public function listLoansForMember(int $memberId, ?string $status = null, int $page = 1, int $pageSize = 20): array
    {
        if ($page < 1) {
            throw new LibraryException('page must be a positive integer');
        }
        if ($pageSize < 1 || $pageSize > 100) {
            throw new LibraryException('pageSize must be between 1 and 100');
        }

        $matching = $this->loans->forMember($memberId);
        if ($status !== null) {
            $matching = array_values(array_filter($matching, fn(Loan $l) => $l->status === $status));
        }

        $total = count($matching);
        $pageLoans = array_slice($matching, ($page - 1) * $pageSize, $pageSize);

        return ['loans' => $pageLoans, 'total' => $total, 'page' => $page, 'pageSize' => $pageSize];
    }
}

        if ($book !== null) {
            $book->availableCopies++;

     * 'loans' (this page's slice), 'total' (count of ALL matching

     */
    public function listLoansForMember(int $memberId, ?string $status = null, int $page = 1, int $pageSize = 20): array
    {
        if ($page < 1) {
            throw new LibraryException('page must be a positive integer');
        }
        if ($pageSize < 1 || $pageSize > 100) {
            throw new LibraryException('pageSize must be between 1 and 100');
        }

        $all = $this->loans->forMember($memberId);
